description: 主要道路一般交通量 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 生駒市. 交通量の観測をしていない地点（下線を引いた部分）については、推定した交通量を記載している。 資料：平成22年度道路交通センサス. Coverage: 生駒市. The portal files it under the publisher 生駒市. Its tags are 交通, 道路. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
